title: Leome and Partners footer
description: A footer framed by a backdrop photo: an inset flat panel with a large mark, a column of 24px links and an opening-hours note with a small square, the firm's name set across the full width whose letters rise one after another as it scrolls in, and a row of small uppercase legal links. Links roll letter by letter on hover.
notes: the wordmark is 11vw (10.2vw on phones): about 14–16 characters fill the width
the frame shows the media; empty, it is a soft glow gradient
the letter rise is CSS scroll-driven; off under prefers-reduced-motion
name: leome-and-partners-footer

props.name: mark
props.description: the brand mark shown large at the top-left, e.g. a lucide icon

props.name: links
props.description: the main links, in a column

props.name: hours
props.description: a small block beside the links: a heading line, then its lines (opening hours, address…)

props.name: wordmark
props.description: the firm's name, set across the panel; its letters rise one by one as it scrolls in

props.name: credit
props.description: the small credit at the bottom-left

props.name: legal
props.description: small legal links along the bottom (two read best)

props.name: note
props.description: the short note at the bottom-right, e.g. the year

props.name: media
props.description:
A backdrop photo filling the whole footer; it shows as a frame around the panel. Give it
`className="size-full object-cover"`. A soft glow gradient when empty.
